name: Allen Clay
life: “I still remember lifting a faded receipt out of its gilded frame.” Wednesday often includes a stop at the steps at Pier Beach, where Allen watches the working part of the waterfront before turning toward the open water.
voice: I found the father's first rent receipt. It is framed in the corner where he tells young people to start from nothing.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a moss-green cardigan and a pair of reading glasses in a cloth sleeve. Allen has a heart-shaped face and prominent ears, with a loose dark braid. Allen looks at people's hands before looking at what they carry during a conversation.
personality: Allen has a strong competitive streak and a very soft spot for the person finishing last. A prize tastes better when everybody had enough time to enter.
agenda: To bring the father's framed rent receipt to the conversation.
family: Fiona Nord is Allen’s younger cousin. Allen brings whatever was actually growing or affordable that week. Fiona makes room at the table. The meal sometimes produces a solution. Even when it does not, everyone goes away knowing what the other household is up against. Asked about *The margin reader*, Fiona says, “I recognized my old teacher by the way she corrects a question mark.”
connections: John Machado. An early rent receipt substantiates a business partner's account of the father's own struggle for independence.

reactions.situation: A tenant hears about the building sale secondhand
reactions.response: Allen gives the tenant a reliable contact for the sale information and a real date to expect an answer.

reactions.situation: A frightened child is waiting outside a shuttered shop
reactions.response: Allen stays where the child can see the shop door and asks the neighboring counter to help find the adult expected there.

reactions.response: Allen explains exactly what help was offered and offers the same practical help to the accuser.
reactions.asWritten: If accused of favoritism, Allen explains exactly what help was offered and offers the same practical help to the accuser.
